label: Transcript Quantification Benchmarking
summary: Three preprints address transcript-level quantification ambiguity with k-mer self-benchmarking, transcript-specific regions, and context-aware long-read MAPQ…
synthesis: The dominant thread is reducing ambiguity and bias in transcript-level quantification. GaussF is alignment-free, uses GC-stratified k-mer Gaussian CDF self-benchmarking, and is benchmarked against Kallisto and Salmon. A minimal-sharing k-mer strategy isolates transcript-specific regions to lower mapping ambiguity. CALMeR replaces fixed long-read MAPQ thresholds with transcript-context-conditioned filtering via zero-one inflated beta regression, improving spike-in transcript recovery. Adjacent long-read work covers neighboring steps: DirectClean handles artifacts and rescues ONT direct-cDNA reads, SQANTI-evidence annotates unannotated genomes, and LRP2 adds mass-spectrometry evidence for protein isoforms. The mitochondrial RNA processing tool, Edi-Set-Flow, Ribotools and tModBase v2.0 address narrower questions outside the quantification focus.
